name: Iron Titan
look: a white barrel-bodied titan under a black dome of glowing green crystals, with gold shoulder caps, a black front panel of yellow lights between columns of coloured rings, banded arms and a glowing pink orb in one hand
entry: A Pokémon resembling Regigigas, described in a report about a titan that woke in a city deep under the earth. It needs no warming up: the orb in its hand charges in an instant, and the rings on its chest light up one by one before it throws a punch.
how: Wild: very rare in ancient cities, deep underground.
